title: Maximum Length Substring With Two Occurrences
summary: Given a string s , return the maximum length of a substring where each character appears no more than twice.
statement: Given a string s , return the maximum length of a substring where each character appears no more than twice.
constraints: Find the longest contiguous substring in which no character appears more than twice.
All characters in the substring count, not just consecutive repetitions.
hints: Maintain a window whose character counts never exceed two.
When the newly added character reaches three, move left until its count returns to two.
Record the largest valid window length after shrinking.
Only the arriving character can violate the invariant, and the minimal shrink retains the longest valid window ending at each right index.
editorial: Only the arriving character can violate the invariant, and the minimal shrink retains the longest valid window ending at each right index.

tests.explanation: The longest valid window has length four.
Any valid substring contains at most two a characters, so the answer is two.
